errors.text_span: starts at approximately 47% accuracy at epoch 0
errors.evidence: The description states the train and validation lines start at approximately 47%, but the plot shows them both starting at approximately 45%.

errors.text_span: a peak around epoch 20 at about 95%
errors.evidence: This is an inaccurate description of the trend. While the value at epoch 21 is approximately 95%, the value at epoch 20 is much lower (~83.5%). More importantly, this phrasing misses the most significant feature of the blue line, which is reaching and plateauing at 100% accuracy from epoch 27 to 29.

The blue 'Train' line does not end at 98%. It reaches 100% accuracy at epoch 27 and stays there until the last data point at epoch 29. The x-axis extends to 30, but the final data point is at epoch 29 with a value of 100%.

errors.text_span: ending at approximately 82% accuracy at epoch 30
errors.evidence: The last data point for the green 'Validation' line is at epoch 29, not epoch 30. The accuracy value of ~82% is a reasonable approximation for the value at epoch 29 (~82.5%).
